correctness.rationale: The edge-incidence map is an isometry from real Lip0(P) into ℓ∞ of 15 edges. Injectivity of the target cube identifies the absolute and fixed relative constants. Group averaging lowers arbitrary projection norms to those of S5-equivariant projections. Exact stabilizer orbit analysis leaves three signed row parameters; the retraction equations a+2b=1, b=2c and trace relation 15a=9 force a=3/5,b=1/5,c=1/10. A Hodge-gradient projection constructed using Petersen A²=2I−A+J realizes all rows with norm 11/5. Exact-rational graph/stabilizer/projector calculations were replayed; the proof independently establishes global optimality and confines uniqueness to equivariant projections.

value.rationale: An exact absolute projection constant for a canonical natural nonplanar arc-transitive graph produces a specific previously unaccounted nine-dimensional Banach-space invariant. The proof also characterizes the unique symmetry-equivariant optimal projector and its rational edge kernel, producing a reusable test case for symmetry-reduced projection methods. It is a complete exact natural invariant rather than a routine coordinate example, and does not assert any unproved broader classification.
